title: Manage E-Plans
acceptance_criteria: 9.4.1 Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to create, a. E-Plans  For non-shared firms, and individual E-Plans have not been created, system shall display the status as ‘Pending Individual E-Plan’.  For shared firms, agency shall create their respective individual E-Plans. The Coordinating Agency shall work with the other requesting agencies and the firm to come out with the Combined E-Plan to fulfil the requirement for a WOG’s approach with the firm providing essential services.  System shall display the status as ‘Completed’ when individual and/or combined E-Plans are created.  System shall remind Controller Undertakings Office and Controller Undertakings Office three months before the due date of the E-Plan. System shall continue to send monthly reminders if the E-Plan information is still not updated after one year from the date of approval of allocation of the firm. title: Manage Requisition Plans
acceptance_criteria: 9.5.1 Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to create, update, view and delete Undertaking Requisition Plan. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)

9.5.2 System shall have various plan types and Controller Undertakings Office must select ‘Training’, ‘Exercise (Others)’, Exercise (invoke RORA) or ‘Operation’ when creating an Undertaking Requisition plan. a. ‘Exercise (Others)’ – Peacetime exercise that is carried out without invoking RORA and it is through arrangement with the firm such as contractual arrangement. There is no need to create an Undertaking Requisition Plan in CRIPS. Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to update the exercise completion details in CRIPS. b. ‘Exercise (invoke RORA)’ – CRA will need to obtain Minister for Defence’s approval to invoke RORA for a specific time period for the exercise.

9.5.3 Controller Undertakings Office shall create an undertaking requisition plan as the requisition process shall be executed using CRIPS. The services required can be imported and selected from the schedule of services created prior. c. If the selected Requisition Plan type is ‘Training’, ‘Exercise (invoke RORA)’ or ‘Operation’ type, Chief Controller Office shall receive an email notification to approve the undertaking requisition plan.
9.5.4 Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to Create Requisition Plan, Complete Requisition Plan, and Submit Requisition Plan for Approval.

title: Manage Requisition
acceptance_criteria: 9.6.1 Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to update and view existing Undertakings Requisition Plans.

9.6.2 System shall trigger the appropriate workflow based on the type of requisition plan, a. ‘Exercise (Others)’ – Controller Undertakings Office shall only be required to update the basic details of the exercise. Upon the completion of the exercise, Controller Undertakings Office shall update the plan details and set to ‘Closed’ status. Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to cancel requisition plan that has not been closed. b. c. ‘Exercise (invoke RORA)’ – Chief Controller Office must approve the requisition plan before Controller Undertakings Office can execute the requisition process in CRIPS. Given that exercises are pre-planned, Controller Undertakings Office shall not be allowed to add new services or import from the E-Plan’s schedule of services after the requisition plan has been approved. ‘Operation’ – The workflow is similar to Exercise (invoke RORA) and shall have flexibility. During the requisition phase, Controller Undertakings Office shall be allowed to include new services or import from schedule of services maintained in the E-Plan. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED) d. e. RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 ‘Training’ – The workflow is similar to Exercise (invoke RORA) and shall have flexibility to include new schedule of services during the requisition phase. As this is for internal training, email notifications shall not be sent to the POC of the firms included in the requisition plan. Instead, they shall be sent to the Controller Undertakings Office who created the requisition plan. The compensation process is not applicable for training plans. Undertaking Requisition Plans shall have one of following statuses at any point in time,  Planning – Upon the creation of the plan.  Pending Approval – When Controller Undertakings Office submit the plan to Chief Controller Office for approval.  Pending Requisition – After the plan is approved by Chief Controller Office but the requisition has not yet started. At this stage, Notice of Direction (NOD) is not printed and issued to the firm.  Requisition – This stage is where NOD Acknowledgement is received, and the actual requisition process has commenced.  TNOD Issued – When the Termination of NOD is issued with outstanding services.  Closed - Requisition Plan is completed with no further action required. Exercise (Others) Exercise (invoke RORA), Operation, Training Planning Planning Closed Pending Approval Pending Requisition Requisition TNOD Issued Closed

9.6.3 Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to import Schedule of Services that was maintained when creating individual/ combined E-Plans. If Schedule of Services was not maintained in E-Plans, Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to create the Schedule of Services in the undertaking requisition plan.
9.6.4 Controller Undertakings Office shall update the quantity of each service required for the requisition plan.

9.6.5 Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to save the undertaking requisition plan as draft. Upon finalising all the details in the requisition plan, Controller Undertakings Office shall submit the plan. Except for Exercise (Others) requisition plan, an email notification shall be sent to inform Chief Controller Office of a plan pending his/her approval.

Each NOD shall have a unique number, e.g. NOD00001. The firm is required to acknowledge the NOD after the agency serve the NOD to them. Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to update the acknowledgement details in CRIPS.

Specific only to requisition plan created with ‘Operation’ type, Controller Undertakings Office shall be allowed to add new services or import additional schedule of services. title: Reports
acceptance_criteria: 9.7.1 Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to generate a. Undertakings Requirement Approval Status Report. This report gives an overview of the status of requests for companies/firms by the requesting agency. The report also has information such as the approval dates by the various stakeholders given that each request is routed through multiple agencies. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Lead Agency, Submission From Dates and Current Status. Essential Firms (by Agency) Report. This report generates the list of firms by Requesting Agencies. When generating the report, users shall be able to select the period and registration status (e.g. all status, rejected, deregistered firms). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Lead Agency and Allocated From Dates. Essential Firms (by Company) Report. This report generates the list of firms by company/firm. The report shall show if the Company is ‘Individual’ or ‘Shared’, and if it is ‘Shared’, it shall show the list of agencies that have registered the company. When generating the report, users shall be able to select the period and registration status (e.g. all status, rejected, deregistered firms). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Coordinating Agency and the Allocated from dates. Undertakings Readiness (by Agency) Report. This report generates a summary of firms’ readiness covering the E-Plan and Exercise status by Requesting Agencies. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm and the range of the approval dates. Undertakings Readiness (by Company) Report. This report generates a summary of firms’ readiness covering the E-Plan and Exercise status by company/firm. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm and the range of the approval dates. Essential Firm Security Clearance Status Report. This report generates the status of security clearance of companies. When generating the report, users shall be able to select the clearance status (e.g. all status, submitted, approved, pending, rejected). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm and Security Clearance. Essential Firm Security Re-Clearance Report. This report generates the list of companies that are subjected to security re-clearance. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm, Security Expiry Date, Re-clearance status. Schedule of Service Report. This report generates a listing of the Schedule of Service of the firms. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency and Essential Firm. d. e. f. g. h. title: Dashboard
acceptance_criteria: 9.8.1 Undertakings Dashboard shall be divided into three key sections a. CR Allocation (Undertakings) focus on demand fulfilment status. b. CR Planning (Undertakings) focus on E-Plan Readiness, Requisition Readiness. c. CR Requisition (Undertakings) focus on the overall requisition/ derequisition status.

9.8.2 Aside from CR Allocation (‘Lead Agency’ selected), all Undertakings Dashboards shall have the same functionality and can be drilled down to three levels a. b. c. Aggregated at Level 1 – Display all (i.e. MINDEF/SAF and WOG).
9.8.3 Aggregated at Level 2 – Display at Ministry-level.
9.8.4 Aggregated at Level 3 – Display at Requesting Agency Level (e.g. RSAF, SPF, MAS, PUB, etc.).

title: Manage Firms Information
acceptance_criteria: 10.1.1 System shall list Controller Undertakings as one of the Lead Agencies for selection under the Lead Agency field.
10.1.2 System shall have flexibility such that Lead Agency can manage the firm’s information without having to de-register and re-register the firm.

10.1.3 For undertakings registered by my agency, system shall allow Lead Agency to edit and view information of the company, e.g. a. the company’s Point of Contact b. Internal comments (any notes about the company) For allocated or approved firms, Lead Agency shall be able to update selected information, e.g. addresses, contact details, etc.

10.1.4 When displaying the firm’s name on screen or in generated reports, system shall use the firm’s UEN to retrieve the most updated company name based on ACRA data that is also stored in CRIPS. SSIC of the company shall also be displayed.

10.1.5 For undertakings registered by an agency, system shall allow the Lead Agency of that particular agency to de-register companies that have been allocated by Lead Agency or have been approved by Controller Undertakings. An email notification shall be sent to Controller Undertakings to inform of the de-registration request pending his/her action.
10.1.6 An email notification shall be sent to Lead Agency to inform him/her that Controller Undertakings has deallocated the firm.

10.1.7 Lead Agency shall be able to re-submit security clearance should the approved EF has senior management changes. The re-submission shall be routed to MHA Office for processing, including an email notification to inform MHA Office that there are re-submission requests and require their actions.

title: Manage Allocations
acceptance_criteria: 10.2.1 Upon a Requesting Agency’s submission of a request to register a firm, system shall send an email notification to the Lead Agency for allocation.

10.2.2 Lead Agency shall be able to allocate and reject agency’s requests routed to him/her. Lead Agency shall be able to allocate a company to the request if no preferred company is not indicated in the request. If Lead Agency rejects the request, system shall prompt him/her to enter the reason for rejecting the request.
10.2.3 System shall enable Lead Agency to process the request individually. He/She shall also be able to select multi requests to allocate/reject.
10.2.4 After allocation, if there is more than one agency that requires the firm, system shall update it from ‘Individual’ to ‘Shared’ firm. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)

10.2.5 System shall enable Lead Agency to display all undertaking requirements pending his/her action, a. ‘All’ – This shall be the default selection, and display all Undertaking requirements regardless of their status. b. ‘Requirement’ – Display all Undertaking requirements with the ‘Review Requirement’ status, i.e. requirements rejected from Lead Agency due to various reasons (e.g. incomplete information). c. ‘Allocation’ – Display all Undertaking requirements with ‘Pending Allocation’, ‘Pending De-Allocation’ or ‘Rejected Security Clearance’ status. d. ‘Company Details’ – Display all requirements that are pending Lead Agency’s action to fill in the allocated company details for submission of security clearance (template per MHA’s requirements). e. ‘Clearance’ – Display all Undertaking requirements with ‘Pending Security Clearance’ status, i.e. requirements with company details submitted. f. ‘Approval’ – Display all Undertaking requirements with ‘Pending Approval’ or ‘Pending De-Allocation Approval’ status, i.e. requirements with security clearance accepted. g. ‘Complete’ – Display all Undertaking requirements with ‘Allocated’, ‘De- Allocated’, ‘Rejected’ or ‘Rejected Approval’ status, i.e. Approved Allocations by CRO Undertakings. h. At the end of each tab, system shall show the number of pending requirements in amber to denote there are requirements. No number shall be displayed when there is no pending requirement.
